rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=4, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.01, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-2 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX. (1) iter-1 NUMBERS: SSIM 0.4729, hr 0.0, PSNR 18.55, baseline_PSNR 34.08; elapsed 1097s; naf_per_scene_s=5.0, naf_hidden=128, naf_layers=4, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_lr=1e-2; SLURM [fit] log shows each scene fit only ~85-97 Adam steps (median 91) before the 5.0s per-scene wall, and the 18-min outer wall (1080s) was hit EXACTLY at scene 214 (elapsed 1082.5s). (2) FAILURE MODE: budget-starved per-scene INR fit. A NeRF-style coordinate-MLP wants hundreds-to-thousands of Adam steps to leave its water-mu init; ~91 steps/scene leaves the MLP barely moved -> SSIM 0.4729 well below the LD-FBP baseline. This is starvation, NOT (yet) the structural floor. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_hidden 128->64 (naf_layers=4, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_lr=1e-2, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214 ALL UNCHANGED). 214-SCENE 20-MIN BUDGET MATH (measured): the entire budget is the per-scene fit loop (train_n=0); total = 214 x per_scene_s = 214 x 5.0s = 1070s ~= the 1080s/18-min outer wall, hit exactly at scene 214. I CANNOT raise per_scene_s (214 x wall is already full inside the 20-min compute budget). So to buy MORE Adam steps per scene at FIXED total budget I make each step CHEAPER: per-step cost ~0.055 s/step is the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward PLUS the tunable 512^2-coord MLP forward; halving width 128->64 cuts the dominant hidden x hidden matmuls ~4x, so each 5.0s scene should fit meaningfully more steps -> more useful optimization per scene within the SAME 214 x 1080s/18-min wall. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I shrink naf_hidden 128->64, I expect SSIM to rise above 0.4729 because the cheaper MLP buys more Adam steps per scene, letting the INR move further off its water-mu init within the same per-scene wall. FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays ~0.47 despite more steps, NAF is STRUCTURALLY FBP-bounded on dense rebinned Mayo (wrong inductive bias for dense-view CT), not merely starved. (5) HARD 20-min budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18 min) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall = the governor; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a high cap), val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices, NOT reduced), 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override). (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
